title: Auto satin turns a 75° bend as PE-DESIGN does (Half Stitch off)
description: A 5 mm band bent through 75° in satin with Auto direction, density 3, without under sewing, Half Stitch off: the rung direction turns with the distance along the outer edge, as in PE-DESIGN's file (count within 10 %, longest crossing within 0.5 mm). OpenStitch does not model Half Stitch; PE-DESIGN's count is the same with it on or off.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/satin-auto-bend-75-nohalf.pes (pe-refs-3 bend sweep, 2026-10-28): 175 stitches; the same count with Half Stitch on and off.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw (or import from SVG) the closed polygon (0,0) (30,0) (34.48,16.73) (29.65,18.02) (26.16,5) (0,5) mm (a 5 mm band bent through 75°). Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction Auto, Half Stitch unticked, Density 3.0, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: the longest crossings are in the corner fan
